reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared getScheduledAmount, keeping getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance, so every caller (forecast, schedules app, API, budget template, upcoming list) picks up the rule.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the rule stays in one function.

placement.why: The rule is edited where it is already defined, in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: A two-line rule change, updated tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Math.min and 'amount - threshold' express 'lowest allowed value' directly and are simpler than the code they replace.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All callers continue to go through getScheduledAmount.
